narr: A lingering front near the I-10 corridor combined with an upper level trough aloft. These features combined with the sea breezes over a moist and unstable airmass with weak steering flow produced flooding rainfall over parts of Jacksonville and a few pulse severe storms that had wet downbursts.
ev: At 515 pm, media showed a video on social media of up to 6 inches of water flooding the intersection of Bay Street and Main Street in downtown Jacksonville. At 525 pm, the media relayed a social media video of 6-12 inches of flood water over Park Street near Avondale Avenue in Jacksonville. At 551 pm, the media shared a social media video of Hogan's Creek overflowing it's banks near Bethel Baptist Street and Laura Street. At 553 pm, the public shared a social media video of minor ponding in their yard along Gilmore Street in Riverside. At 554 pm, the public shared another social media post of street flooding in San Marco near Landon and Flagler Avenues. At 556 pm, the public shared a social media photo of their backyard flooding near Little Fishweir Creek by the intersection of Azalea Drive and Hollingworth Street.
